notes.title: Update #5
notes.content:
Completely redone graphics and level design.

[b]Graphics:[/b]
[list]
[*]From lowpoly to textured
[*]Most textures have PBR masks
[*]Ample use of parallax mapping
[/list] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31930817/ad44a8d18e628ce060ecb6fa29629f8d6aabe4b1.png[/img]

[b]Level Design:[/b]
[list]
[*]Every level redone
[*]General geography remains the same
[/list]

[b]Feature changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changelog gap (remember only a fraction)
[*]Highlights for remote interactions
[*]New items: spyglass, lantern, others
[*]Cuttable grass removed for now
[/list]

notes.title: Content Update #3
notes.content:
[b]Sailboat:[/b]
[list]
[*]Access to gained from the boathouse with the purple winged key found in the mountaintop dungeon
[*]Found at boat spawn points afterwards
[*]Currently lever and rudder operated with no realistic wind
[*]No bobbing for VR comfort reasons
[/list] 
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Swimming and diving: overrides teleport movement mode
[*]Maps/scrolls: unrolled with two controllers
[*]Remote pickup with the grip button: picks up the closest item vertically below the calling controller
[*]Improved water graphics
[/list]

notes.title: Content Update #2
notes.content:
[b]Items:[/b]
[list]
[*]Compass: points north at first. Upon using points to the nearest lootable chest
[*]Gold treasure: found all around the world and immediately converted to money upon collection
[/list]
[b]Further persistence:[/b]
[list]
[*]Gold treasure, chunks of items found in the overworld, and doors unlocked with keys are now depletable
[*]Monster spawners and mineral veins have reactivation timers of 60 and 80 minutes respectively. Excluding some puzzle dependent spawners 
[/list]
[b]Minor:[/b]
[list]
[*]Unarmed punching
[*]Drop rates lowered by 60-80%
[*]Saving without quitting reimplemented and autosaving removed
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Gem merchant properly accepts all gems again
[*]Emerald Wand targeting errors
[/list]

notes.title: Content Update #1
notes.content:
[b]Toys and magic items:[/b]
[list]
[*]Emerald Staff: used to move emeralds and emerald infused material by levitation
[*]Copper Stopwatch: slows down time for 16 seconds
[*]Sapphire Staff: shoots a blue fire bolt 
[*]Crystal Staff: shoots lightnings that damage an enemy
[*]Ruby Staff: slows down time for an enemy while used
[/list]
[b]Ore veins and mining:[/b]
[list]
[*]Mined with hammers
[*]Currently only used to exchange for toys or fiscal gold in the gem exchange. Or as a puzzle element (emeralds)
[*]Coal, iron, copper, proper gold, ruby, crystal, emerald, sapphire
[/list]
[b]Bushes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Destroyed with swords or by uprooting
[*]Occasionally drop coins
[/list]
[b]Bomb Walls:[/b]
[list]
[*]Destroyed with Fire Flasks
[/list]

[b]Retroactive changes and bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated grip angles for vive controllers
[*]Iron Mines simplified and turned into a mining location foremost
[*]Sledgehammer now received in the Iron Mines or bought from the weapons merchant
[*]Sledgehammer puzzle elements in the Mountaintop Dungeon replaced with emerald locks and the Emerald Staff
[*]Saving now requires "save and quit" or walking to a Save Platform to prevent fast travel without using the Greekfire Flasks
[*]Some treasure chests now give ores instead of mostly fiscal gold
[/list]

[b]Trivial:[/b]
[list]
[*]Game shouldn't ask for firewall access anymore
[*]Removed an excess empty Soul Gem platform from the Iron Mines
[*]Some other minor things
[/list]
